name: Context Menu
description: Right-click menu for rows, cards and canvases that opens at the pointer, on touch long-press or via Shift+F10/Menu key; per-target item lists, submenus, checkbox items, labels, shortcuts and destructive items on top of the CRM dropdown menu.

props.name: items
props.description: Menu entries, or a builder from the clicked element

usage: Wrap a list or table once and resolve the row from target.closest('[data-id]') in the items builder. Mirror actions in a visible row menu for discoverability.
